mapper.select: SELECT id, title, keywords, response_message, is_active, created_at, updated_at FROM conversation_blocks WHERE is_active = true ORDER BY id
SELECT id, title, keywords, response_message, is_active, created_at, updated_at FROM conversation_blocks ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT id, title, keywords, response_message, is_active, created_at, updated_at FROM conversation_blocks WHERE title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{title}, '%') ORDER BY title
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO conversation_blocks (title, keywords, response_message, is_active, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{title}, #{keywords}, #{responseMessage}, COALESCE(#{isActive}, true), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.update: UPDATE conversation_blocks SET title = #{title}, keywords = #{keywords}, response_message = #{responseMessage}, is_active = #{isActive}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE conversation_blocks SET is_active = #{isActive}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
